changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0026. Store OpenAI-compatible LLM connections and their models. The API key column holds protected ciphertext, never a plaintext key. Index review: UX_LlmConnections_IsDefault allows one active default; IX_LlmModels_ConnectionId lists models for a connection; UX_LlmModels_Connection_Default allows one default model per connection. Performance note: the runtime reads the single default row, and model lists are bounded by one connection.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE app.LlmConnections ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, Name NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, Provider NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, BaseUrl NVARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, ProtectedApiKey NVARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, DefaultModel NVARCHAR(200) NULL, IsActive BIT NOT NULL, IsDefault BIT NOT NULL, TimeoutSeconds INT NOT NULL, LastTestedAt DATETIME2 NULL, HealthStatus NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, LastLatencyMs INT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_LlmConnections PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_LlmConnections_Provider CHECK (Provider = N'OpenAiCompatible'), CONSTRAINT CK_LlmConnections_Health CHECK (HealthStatus IN (N'NotTested', N'Healthy', N'Failed')), CONSTRAINT CK_LlmConnections_Timeout CHECK (TimeoutSeconds BETWEEN 1 AND 60) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_LlmConnections_IsDefault ON app.LlmConnections (IsDefault) WHERE IsDefault = 1 AND DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_LlmConnections_Name ON app.LlmConnections (Name) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;
CREATE TABLE app.LlmModels ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, ConnectionId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, ModelIdentifier NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, DisplayName NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, IsActive BIT NOT NULL, IsDefault BIT NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_LlmModels PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_LlmModels_LlmConnections FOREIGN KEY (ConnectionId) REFERENCES app.LlmConnections (Id) ); CREATE INDEX IX_LlmModels_ConnectionId ON app.LlmModels (ConnectionId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_LlmModels_Connection_Default ON app.LlmModels (ConnectionId) WHERE IsDefault = 1 AND DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_LlmModels_Connection_Identifier ON app.LlmModels (ConnectionId, ModelIdentifier) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE app.LlmModels; DROP TABLE app.LlmConnections;
